metadata.title: Russia's Mars Probe Fell Back to Earth
metadata.description:
Mars 96 re-entered the atmosphere instead of leaving for Mars. The cause: failure of the second burn of the upper stage, leaving the probe in Earth orbit.

Failure chain: Launch reaches parking orbit → Second burn fails → Probe stranded → Orbit decays → Re-entry with plutonium sources

Related episode: Neil Armstrong's Spacecraft Spun Out of Control — https://youtu.be/QLSnrXyCJgw

Series — Spaceflight Disasters: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLE-TBpT2OeaM

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Mars 96 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars_96
• NASA — mars96 timeline.txt (cited by Wikipedia) — http://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/text/mars96_timeline.txt

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
